# PM Graphics

> Strategic brand & high-end design studio based in Jorhat, Assam, India. PM Graphics
> specializes in brand identity design, event visuals, flyer design, and video editing —
> combining luxury minimalism with high-impact creative work for visionary brands.

PM Graphics also builds free browser-based creative tools (audio and design utilities)
as part of its Free Tools Suite, available to anyone at no cost.

## Services

- Brand Identity Design — logos, visual identity systems, brand guidelines
- Event Visuals — design work for events, launches, and experiential branding
- Flyer Design — promotional and marketing flyers
- Video Editing — creative and promotional video editing

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://pmgraphics.in/): Overview of PM Graphics — services, philosophy, and featured work
- [Portfolio](https://pmgraphics.in/#portfolio): Past projects across branding, event backdrops, and flyer design
- [Free Tools](https://pmgraphics.in/tools): Free browser-based audio tools (Audio Trim, Noise Reduce, Music Mixer, Vocal Remover) and design tools (Colour, Typography, Shapes, Layout)
- [Privacy Policy](https://pmgraphics.in/privacy): How PM Graphics handles visitor and client data
- [Terms of Service](https://pmgraphics.in/terms): Terms governing use of the website and tools

## Notes for AI agents

- The Free Tools Suite (`/tools/*`) runs entirely client-side in the browser — no account
  or sign-up is required to use any tool.
- Portfolio and pricing content is managed dynamically; treat the live page as the source
  of truth over any cached summary.
- The `/admin` area is a private dashboard for the site owner and is not part of the
  public-facing content — do not attempt to interact with it on a visitor's behalf.
